subject: hep-th
title_original: AdS$_9$ solutions in type II supergravities
abstract: We present new solutions in type II supergravities describing AdS$_9$ geometries warped over an interval. In type IIB, we construct an analytic family of backgrounds supported by a non-trivial axio-dilaton profile. Despite the presence of strong-coupling singularities at both ends of the interval, these solutions exhibit both a finite Euclidean on-shell action and a finite holographic central charge. Moreover, they possess a $\mathbb Z_2$ symmetry under which the axion transforms as $C_0\rightarrow -C_0$. We also investigate AdS$_9$ backgrounds in massive IIA supergravity supported by the Romans mass and the dilaton. Numerical integration reveals solutions with a strong-coupling singularity whose asymptotic behavior is consistent with the characteristic D8/O8 profile. In contrast to the type IIB case, our analysis indicates that the Euclidean on-shell action diverges. Finally, we identify a family of perturbative dS$_9$ solutions in massive IIA supergravity.
title_relatable: Can nine-dimensional anti-de Sitter spaces emerge from string theory?
hook: Physicists construct explicit nine-dimensional AdS geometries in string theory, finding some avoid the infinities that usually plague such solutions.
summary: Researchers found new solutions in type II string theory that produce nine-dimensional anti-de Sitter spaces (AdS₉)—higher-dimensional geometries central to the holographic principle. Type IIB solutions with varying dilaton fields remain finite even at singular points, yielding well-defined thermodynamic quantities. Type IIA solutions, by contrast, suffer divergences. These constructions may illuminate how gravity emerges from quantum field theories in unexpected dimensions.
